note: Greenhouse (glass plant structure) and archive (records repository) are unrelated building types, merely co-hyponyms in a disaster-destruction template.
Skylight (roof window) and boiler (heating appliance) are unrelated building components sharing only a size-description template.
Descent (a downward journey) and repair (a fix) are unrelated activities that merely share a difficulty-adjective template.
Greenhouse is a physical building while fire is a destructive event; entirely different ontological categories.
"Form" (constitute/create, chemistry sense) and "speak" (talk) share no semantic overlap.
Proposal (a submitted plan) and manuscript (a written work) are distinct document types sharing only an accept/reject-panel template.
Ward (a hospital location) and shepherd (a person/occupation) are different ontological categories, merely sharing a walk-through/along template.
Car and automobile denote the same vehicle class, but automobile carries a more formal/technical register.
Speak (communicate) and follow (pursue/succeed to a role) are semantically unrelated verbs.
Replace (substitute a person in a role) and produce (create/oversee a work) have unrelated meanings.
Spoil_mound is a physical dirt-pile object while "large" is a scalar size property; a category mismatch, not synonymy.
Mural (a wall painting) and frame (a structural/metal frame) are different object types sharing only a collaborative-work template.
"New" (recency) and "big" (size) describe different property dimensions, not synonyms.
Bench (furniture/seat) and spoil_mound (excavation waste pile) are unrelated physical object types.
Committee (a group of people) and bench (a physical seat) are ontologically distinct, agent vs. object.
Hatch (a small opening/door) is at best part of a roof, not identical to it — a meronym, not a synonym.
